headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, and major editorial blocks. Always use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, UI elements, dashboard data.

mono.usage: Tags, status indicators, tiny metadata, overlines (uppercase + wide tracking).

rules: Never use pure black or white. Backgrounds are Alabaster/Museum White (#F9F8F6) and text is Pitch Black (#0F0F0F).
Avoid standard SaaS gradients. Use flat, solid colors with a tactile feel.
Primary actions should use the dark obsidian color, while decorative or success states can use the terracotta or olive accents.
Limit the use of primary color strictly to the most critical CTAs.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Neumorphism (Tactile Variant)' mixed with 'Grid Borders'. Flat solid backgrounds for cards with a crisp 1px border-black/10 and subtle shadow (shadow-sm). Never use muddy glassmorphism in the main reading areas.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton in dashboard views. Use border-r border-b for grid items to give a 'Technical/Editorial' structure.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a very subtle SVG noise overlay fixed in the background with opacity-5 to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Light weight) for an elegant, high-end feel.

component_name.consultant_chat: Do not build generic chat bubbles. Build 'Editorial Ribbons'. The AI's questions should look like large H2 headers. User inputs should be clean, large textarea or elegant form inputs below it.
component_name.action_plan_blocks: Use Shadcn Cards heavily customized to look like an executive brief. No rounded corners larger than 'rounded-md'. Use grid columns for 'Situación Actual', 'Causas', 'Prioridades', etc.
component_name.kanban_dashboard: Cardless approach for the columns. Use thin lines to separate columns. Tasks are rectangular flat blocks with mono-spaced tags.
component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangles. hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200. Text must contrast strictly.

grids.landing: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid. md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical layout. Lots of negative space.
grids.dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Strict hierarchy.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, py-24. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8).
layouts.alignment: Paragraphs left-aligned. Main question ('¿Qué quieres lograr?') left-aligned or optically centered if serving as a massive hero text.
layouts.navigation: Solid background (bg-[#F9F8F6]) with 1px border-b. No transparent headers. Clear logo + 3-5 links + Primary CTA.
layouts.dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation (border-r) + main content area. Strict, objective, and functional.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-ins and slight vertical lifts for dashboard data and action plan blocks (framer-motion or simple CSS keyframes).
motion.interactions: Hover states must lift the element slightly and adjust border/shadow. Focus states must have high contrast rings.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to minimum 4.5:1 for text. Hover states must explicitly set text color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='goal-input', data-testid='submit-goal-button').

media.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Images should have a subtle dark overlay (bg-black/10) to blend into the editorial design if text is placed on them.

image_urls.description: Artist in studio. Represents the target audience (creatives) in their natural environment.
Contemporary art gallery interior. Evokes the museum/gallery strategic aesthetic.
Art gallery hallway. Represents the destination/success for cultural projects.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not highly recommended for this specific 'sober, accessible, reliable' consultancy UI. Keep the focus heavily on typography and editorial flow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono.
Install Framer Motion: yarn add framer-motion
Override default Shadcn configurations to match the custom colors (Alabaster base, Obsidian text).
Do NOT build generic chat interfaces (user right, bot left bubbles). The interaction should feel like filling an interactive canvas or brief.
Ensure the hero question '¿Qué quieres lograr?' uses the h1 serif typography and feels deeply personal and authoritative.
Use standard `.js` files for components since TypeScript is not enforced. Ensure components are modular.
Dashboard should be flat, without excessive card dropshadows. Rely on grid borders and crisp padding.
All text must be in Spanish.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make it distinct.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or heavily left-aligned grids.
Create depth through layered design elements and border hierarchies.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯. Use Phosphor icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use sonner for toasts. Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
